Google announced users can toggle off visible AI watermarks across models like Nano Banana and Flow, relying instead on invisible SynthID and C2PA standards for backend identification.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing WHAT (visible marker) with WHO (origin tracking). Google separates surface aesthetics from deep provenance.

By maintaining invisible technical standards while granting aesthetic flexibility, the system balances user empowerment with institutional accountability without resorting to heavy-handed controls.

When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Grace. The minor friction of removed visible tags is offset by robust invisible standards.

The Unavoidable Truth: Invisible verification protocols preserve essential accountability.

The Unavoidable Lie: Removing visible markers has zero impact on public misidentification risks.
